name: Josep Tarradellas Barcelona-El Prat Airport

runway.v: three runways; the longest, 06L/24R, is 3,352 m long and 60 m wide

slots.v: in summer, general aviation slots (arrival and departure) are coordinated no more than 30 days ahead
slots.quote: During the summer season, general aviation slots (arrival + departure) will not be coordinated more than 30 days in advance.

max_aircraft.v: from June to September, aircraft of 15,000 kg MTOW or less cannot arrive between 07:00 and 11:30
max_aircraft.quote: they cannot operate arrivals within the time period 0700-1130

handling.v: the AIP lists AVIAVIP FBO, United Aviation FBO, ExecuJet Spain, General Aviation Service, Jetex Executive Aviation Barcelona, Skyvalet and Universal Aviation Spain as general aviation agents and FBO managers
handling.quote: General Aviation agents and General and Business Aviation terminal Managers (FBO):

noise.v: a special night runway configuration is used between 23:00 and 07:00 local
noise.quote: Night time configuration between 2300 and 0700 LT:

ppr.v: in the summer season, aircraft of ICAO code letter D or larger staying between 05:00 and 10:59 UTC must give notice at least 15 days before arrival (stay limited to 36 hours)
ppr.quote: scheduled to stay between 05:00 and 10:59 UTC, must notify this operation

notes: Night-time noise operating restrictions are in AD 2-LEBL item 21.1 sections 5 and 6, which the HTML page as read did not contain (the 15,000 kg 07:00-11:30 rule time basis not stated; excludes ambulance, emergency, State and some public service flights). The night runway configuration is not a curfew. Ramp-0 is for corporate and private aircraft only. Header shows WEF 01-OCT-26 and WEF 03-SEP-26. Re-researched 2026-10-29: AD 2.21 (Amdt 408/26) defines night as 2300-0700 LT. It found no ban on movements at night, only runway limits: at night, RWY 24R/06L may be used only by aircraft that ask for it and can justify needing the longer runway, and reverse thrust above idle is forbidden on RWY 06L/24R and 02. The AIP does not say there is no curfew, so curfew stays missing. Amdt 408/26 pages are dated 09-JUL-26; the consolidated HTML page (WEF 01-OCT-26) may be newer but could not be reopened (permission prompt not answered). The consolidated LEBL PDF on aip.enaire.es is stale (pages WEF 11-JUL-24, AIRAC AMDT 06/24, showing the old 0700-0959 summer arrival window): do not use it.
